programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Real Madrid - Barcelona
programme.desc: Nuevo episodio en la rivalidad que marca el paso en LaLiga. Real Madrid y Barcelona se miden en el Bernabéu con el liderato en juego. Los blancos, con dos puntos de ventaja, pueden poner tierra de por medio. Los culés han salido airosos en los últimos Clásicos.

programme.title: Decoded

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: David Dickinson and the team head to Telford, where Alison Chapman decides diamonds are her best friend and Tony Geering is in a gambling mood going head-to-head with another dealer. Plus, Stewart Hoffgartner puts down the big bucks for an adventurous pocket watch.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Kristian tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Simon from Chesterfield, Claire from Altrincham, Buzz from Southend-on-Sea and Rosemary from Gloucester pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Marnie heads to market to pick a Jacob ram for her flock and Kelvin focuses on the breeds that bring in money. The family decide to have a night away camping in their own woodland.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Kev is keen to make a good impression, while Steve has plans up at Home Farm and Joe smells a rat.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Jodie's unexpected arrival overshadows Harper's welcome-home party, Sam bonds with Idris over his struggles, and Cassie produces one of Ross's ex-girlfriends in a bid to reveal his true colours.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: Monica attempts to put her family's safety first, but she races into action when the killer's identity is discovered and she has the opportunity to save his final victim. Meanwhile, Nichol tries to get his mother to finally leave her husband and consider a future without him.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: A look at the case of American influencer Alexis Sharkey, who was declared missing in November 2020 by her husband Thomas Sharkey. When her body was found on a side road by a truck driver shortly after, detectives began an investigation that led to her spouse. However, just two weeks after the body was found, he also disappeared without trace.

programme.title: Love & Death
programme.desc: A sense of normality returns after Candy is forced to take stock of her marriage, but Pat soon makes a discovery that leads him to seek answers from Sherry. Crime drama, starring Elizabeth Olsen and Jess Plemons.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: When businesswoman Kathleen Peterson is found dead after reportedly falling down a flight of stairs at her North Carolina home, the unusually bloody scene leads police to focus their attention on her husband, author and aspiring local politician Michael Peterson. While the Petersons' blended family rallies around the patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture perfect marriage into question. Fact-based drama, starring Colin Firth and Toni Collette.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: Dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed game show hosted by Ben Shephard, as plucky players and famous faces alike take on the machine for its £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase

programme.title: Inside the Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel
programme.desc: Wedding planner Meri pulls out all the stops to deliver a breathtaking and ultra-exclusive ceremony while managing director Stefan gathers staff to announce some major news following a recent inspection. Culinary fans gather across the hotel as chef Michel Roux hosts a masterclass at the cookery school.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Vinny's jealousy could be causing a problem, while Graham goes snooping around the depot and Billy and Dawn bond.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: David and Shona confront Jodie over the contents of her trinket box, Idris delivers a shock to Alya, and Cassie fumes as Ross reveals his intention to stay local after securing a steady job.

programme.title: Cold Case Forensics: The Death of God's Banker
programme.desc: Return of the documentary delving into the casebook of world-leading forensic scientist Angela Gallop and her team. When the body of Italian banker Roberto Calvi was found hanging under Blackfriars Bridge in London in 1982, the investigation led to a murky world of financial deals with the Vatican and the Mafia. Nicola Walker narrates.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett search for a $100million heroin consignment brazenly stolen by a French drug kingpin from the police evidence room. However, after a mix-up over a phone call from a potential witness, each cop has to assume the other's identity - Lowrey becoming the henpecked family man and Burnett the playboy. Michael Bay's action thriller, starring Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Tea Leoni, Tcheky Karyo and Theresa Randle.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. As teams of forensic experts on both sides recreate the night of Kathleen's death, Michael's children grapple with shocking new information about their father, while his stepdaughter Caitlin wrestles with her own doubts.

Spy adventure, with Roger Moore in his first appearance as 007, alongside Yaphet Kotto and Jane Seymour.

programme.desc: Wedding planner Meri pulls out all the stops to deliver a breathtaking and ceremony that dreams are made of. Tom later heads to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation.

programme.title: The Chase Around the World

The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Two mismatched undercover cops set out to halt an underground gang war and bring down a drug lord attempting to flood the market with a deadly form of Ecstasy. However, a romantic interlude threatens to drive the investigation off course. Comedy thriller sequel, starring Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Gabrielle Union, Jordi Molla and Peter Stormare.

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Ben Shephard presents as 14 people from all walks of life come together to attempt to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks and win a share £200,000. With their progress tracked by the menacing Mountain's Keeper, they have just 14 days to make the 100km journey across treacherous terrain and perilous crossings. Pub landlady Miranda must face her fears and prove she is not slowing the group down, while self-styled 'shark' Dockers singles out his competition and makes an early bid to be a leader. The Mountain's Keeper then tests the group's resolve to get to the summit by forcing them to make a brutal decision, causing tensions to boil over in a dramatic fallout that leaves the team divided.

programme.desc: Contestants try to answer trivia answers correctly to collect spins on a gameboard, where they can win cash and prizes. Unless, of course, they land on a "Whammy," which takes away the player's loot. The contestant with the most accumulated cash and prizes at the end of the show is the winner.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. When the time is up, the team with the most points wins, and the non-celebrity contestants wins cash.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. When the time is up, the team with the most points wins, and the non-celebrity contestants wins cash.

programme.title: Victim to Verdict
programme.desc: More than a decade after Florida State Law professor Dan Markel was gunned down by two Miami hitmen, his former mother-in-law, Donna Adelson, is accused of plotting the murder; her son Charlie and his girlfriend have already been convicted, but prosecutors believe Donna was calling the shots; will the family matriarch and doting grandmother be able to convince the jury she had nothing to do with executing her son-in-law?

programme.title: Victim to Verdict

programme.title: Victim to Verdict

programme.desc: Game 1 of the Western Conference First Round between the Ducks and the Oilers takes place at Rogers Place. Edmonton holds home-ice advantage as the No. 2 seed in the Pacific Division. The Ducks' Cutter Gauthier leads the team in points and goals.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Ducks face the Oilers in Game 2 of the West first round at Rogers Place. Edmonton won the opener 7-4 on Jan. 26, fueled by its power play. Connor McDavid leads the Oilers while Cutter Gauthier leads the Ducks. Anaheim looks to even the series.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Edmonton Oilers take on the Anaheim Ducks at Honda Center for Game 3 of the West first round. The Ducks won Game 2 to tie the series. Cutter Gauthier's second goal of the night broke a 4-4 tie late in the third period to seal the win.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Oilers face the Ducks in Game 4 at Honda Center. Anaheim leads the series after a 7-4 Game 3 win where they broke a 3-3 tie. After Connor McDavid cut it to 5-4, Jeffrey Viel and Jackson LaCombe scored to seal the victory for the Ducks.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: Anaheim Ducks battle Edmonton Oilers in Game 5 of their playoff series at Rogers Place. Anaheim holds a commanding 3-1 series advantage following a thrilling 4-3 overtime victory over Edmonton in Game 4 of the crucial Western Conference matchup.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The best-of-seven series continues as the Ducks play the Oilers in Game 6 at Honda Center. Edmonton won Game 5, while Anaheim leads the series 3-2. Leon Draisaitl scored a tip-in goal and a power-play one-timer in the 4-1 win to secure the victory.

programme.title: City Eats: Charleston
